objective: Establish the actual truth of M9-C45 state and reconcile reported claims against evidence before M9-C46 builds upon them.

reconciliation_findings.claim: M45.2 PENDING in progress record while final architecture describes verify.py mutation as the only authoritative entry point
reconciliation_findings.evidence: runtime/generated/m9-c45/EXECUTION_PROGRESS.md line 51 still says 'M45.2 — Canonical verify.py mutation Enforcement — PENDING'; canonical-path-enforcement.json generated 2026-09-03T00:48:00Z; verify.py:1333-1336 directly delegates to mutation_runner.run_mutation_cli
reconciliation_findings.discrepancy: M45.2 was effectively superseded by the path-enforcement artifact (canonical-path-enforcement.json) which audited and documented delegation. The status was never explicitly transitioned to COMPLETE.
reconciliation_findings.resolution: M45.2 is DEEMED COMPLETE via the canonical-path-enforcement.json audit + the architectural decision that verify.py mutation is the canonical entry point (documented in runtime/ARCHITECTURE-mutation.md). Status will be corrected in the C45 progress record retroactively only via explicit C46 decision log entry, not by silent rewrite.
reconciliation_findings.residual_limitation: Original M45.2 intent was 'enforcement' — code-level enforcement gates against bypasses. No enforcement gate was added; only documentation. Acceptance is partial.

reconciliation_findings.claim: MutationOrchestrator is on the canonical execution path
reconciliation_findings.evidence_against: runtime/ARCHITECTURE-mutation.md line 65 states: 'MutationOrchestrator | mutation_execution/orchestrator.py | M9-C44 architecture (sharding, retries); NOT yet wired into the canonical verify.py mutation path'. mutation_runner.py has zero references to orchestrator. verify.py:1333-1336 directly calls mutation_runner.run_mutation_cli, not orchestrator. grep across runtime/ and backend/ finds zero callers of mutation_execution.orchestrator except the __init__.py export.
reconciliation_findings.discrepancy: C45 mutation-entrypoint-audit.json line 40-42 listed MutationOrchestrator as a 'canonical path' (4 canonical paths identified). This contradicts the architecture doc.
reconciliation_findings.resolution: MutationOrchestrator is NOT canonical. It is a latent architectural capability from C44 that was never wired into verify.py mutation. The C45 audit's 'canonical_paths: 4' count is misleading — the actual canonical execution is exclusively mutation_runner.py. Decision: under M46.9, either (a) wire orchestrator into canonical path with proper contract; or (b) formally document orchestrator as latent architecture not yet activated and exclude it from 'canonical path' enumeration.
reconciliation_findings.residual_limitation: The orchestrator exists as a substantial implementation (~580 lines) with sharding, retries, and MutmutAdapter — but provides no current operational value.

reconciliation_findings.claim: M45.5-M45.24 milestones completed in a compressed work session per progress record lines 213-216
reconciliation_findings.evidence: Each artifact exists with timestamps from 2026-09-03T00:45:00Z through 2026-09-03T01:45:00Z (full-campaign-qualification 01:15, determinism-report 01:25, backend-qualification-decision 01:35, mutation-reliability-metrics 01:45). However: M45.14 mutation-population-completeness.json shows probes failed with exit_code 1 ('failed to collect stats'). M45.6 campaign-recovery-report.json explicitly states 'cache_preserved_through_interrupt: false' and 'this test caught the run before population write which is the simpler correctness scenario'.
reconciliation_findings.discrepancy: M45.14 verdict 'MUTATION_POPULATION_COMPLETE / RETAIN_MUTMUT_3_7_0' is asserted while every probe shows mutmut_exit_code=1. The mutants_generated counts (21/5/9/30/3) appear to be claims or counts from a different run, not actual successful executions.
reconciliation_findings.resolution: M45.14 evidence is UNRELIABLE. The probe methodology produced contradictory artifacts (claimed mutants vs failed exit code). Must be re-run with verified exit_code=0 or an honest verdict. Under M46.10 mutation-population authoritativeness will be re-established.
reconciliation_findings.residual_limitation: Until M46.10 reruns and confirms, the L-ARCH-001 decision (RETAIN_MUTMUT_3_7_0) is provisional.

reconciliation_findings.evidence: See C above. mutation-population-completeness.json stores a probe_results block referencing the l-arch-001-probe directory; results.json shows mutmut_exit_code=1 on every probe.
reconciliation_findings.discrepancy: Verdict 'MUTATION_POPULATION_COMPLETE' is contradicted by the same artifact's own data showing collection failure.
reconciliation_findings.resolution: Cannot accept M45.14 as proven. Population completeness must be re-demonstrated by M46.10.
reconciliation_findings.residual_limitation: Until re-run, the mutmut 3.7.0 retention decision is provisional.

reconciliation_findings.evidence: campaign-recovery-report.json shows: clean_run = 173k/10s/183t; interrupted_run returncode=-15; resumed_run = 173k/10s. invariants counts_match=true, source_tree_restored=true, no_orphan_processes=true. But: 'cache_preserved_through_interrupt: false' and decision text: 'this test caught the run before population write which is the simpler correctness scenario'.
reconciliation_findings.discrepancy: M45.6 demonstrates ONE scenario: SIGTERM before mutmut wrote .meta. It does NOT demonstrate the general case (SIGTERM mid-execution, after partial results, mid-shard). M45.10 qualified by inheritance from M45.6 (per final-certification-report.json limitations).
reconciliation_findings.resolution: M45.6 PARTIAL: only the simplest case is proven. M45.10 INHERITED, not independently qualified. General recovery reliability is NOT proven.
reconciliation_findings.residual_limitation: Mid-execution interrupt/resume, partial-shard resume, and crash-during-cache-write scenarios are unproven.

conclusion: C45 left several claims in a state where artifact data contradicts verdicts. The most consequential contradictions are: (B) MutationOrchestrator is NOT on the canonical path contrary to C45 audit; (C/D) M45.14 mutation-population-completeness verdict is contradicted by its own probe results.json; (E) M45.6 only proves one interrupt scenario. M9-C46 must therefore: under M46.9 settle the orchestrator-vs-runner authority; under M46.10 re-establish population completeness with honest exit codes; under M46.20/22 treat evidence invalidation as the trust boundary.
gate_verdict: M46.0 reconciliation COMPLETE. C45 actual state is now explicit and bounded. M9-C46 may proceed from a documented baseline rather than an unverifiable claim.
